title: Uncanny X-Men #38
desc:
"THE SCAVENGED" PART ONE

The monstrous experiments from the labs beneath the former Graymalkin Prison have borne twisted fruit as four damaged mutants have been made into cheap but brutal knockoffs of Wolverine himself!

And they're after a new ally of the Uncanny X-Men! Their powers were already out of control. But now they have claws.
